items.content_html: SolarisNerja (Path A – Year Zero). MVP built with Next.js, Vercel and lightweight PostgreSQL. Minimal backend at /api/v1/leads. Contracts and logs in English; user-facing UX in Spanish. Enforced CI, protected branches, ADR and post-execution SOP documentation. Client has read-only access. Simple, maintainable and scalable baseline architecture.

items.content_html: Gimme Golf is a mobile-first web app that adds a fun side game to a real round of golf. Players track their normal score while also drawing hole-by-hole challenge cards, earning game points, and competing on an adjusted leaderboard. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, it’s designed to be lightweight, easy to use on the course.
